record_verbatim.objective: Verify FB2-SYS-SYR-000005's four independence criteria - zero processing resources, zero shared supply rails, zero shared communication paths and a stated threshold accuracy - against an explicitly labelled synthetic assumption, because the element the requirement describes does not exist in either profile and cannot be inspected. The assumption is the declared one the corpus already carries for this second barrier: that it is implementable with its own divider, comparator and reference. The measure's substantive output is the separation checklist it enumerates, which is what a design review of the barrier would have to work through, and the explicit statement that no part of it has been verified against anything.

oracle_detail.residual_risk: An assumption-only measure can confirm the requirement is internally coherent and can never confirm the barrier works. A reader who needs the second question answered must read the paired execution record, which reports blocked.
oracle_detail.what_it_still_does_not_prove: It does not prove the barrier is implementable. The assumption says it is, and the assumption is recorded in the corpus as an assumption precisely because that has not been established. The corpus's own safety goal record names the absence of a demonstration of this barrier's independence as the largest open assumption in its ASIL allocation, and this measure does not improve on that.
oracle_detail.what_the_oracle_is_not: It is not source_grounded: no source implements this barrier. It is not an analytical model: no electrical or timing model is computed. It is not a measured reference: nothing was measured.
oracle_detail.why_this_oracle: The oracle is the corpus's own declared assumption for this second barrier and nothing else. The requirement's independence criteria cannot be checked against code or against hardware, because neither exists here, so the only honest oracle is the assumption the corpus already records, applied to enumerate what a verification would need.

preconditions: The assumption that the second barrier is implementable with a separate divider, comparator and reference is the one the corpus already declares for this element, and is adopted here unchanged rather than restated as if it were derived.
No hardware design package for the barrier exists in this corpus.
record_verbatim.regression_selection: Not a regression measure in its present form, because there is nothing to regress against. Re-run when a hardware design package for the barrier exists, when any measurement of it is taken, or when the declared assumption changes - and in all three cases it must be re-authored rather than merely re-run, because a change in any of them changes its oracle kind.
